notes.title: Early Access: 28th October 2022
notes.notes:
On the 28th of October, we will be going into Early Access Mode. 

If you are a private key holder, you will be able to access and download the launcher for the game. This will grant you indefinite access to the game, as the Stardust Launcher is capable of real time updates. The closed alpha build of the game will be <5Gb, so you can be assured that it is storage and performance friendly. 

Alongside this Early Access event, we will start a series of streamer partnerships. This will last throughout launch month. 

As this is still a closed alpha version of the game, please be aware that many features are still unpolished. These include the UI, shaders, shadows, lighting and story quests/content.  The focus here is on the PVP experience, which is what Stardust League prides itself on as the main carrying feature of the game. 

You will also be able to access a feedback channel in the game itself, and your suggestions and feedback would be largely appreciated in helping us refine and improve the game. 

Main features of this closed alpha build 0.1.0:

[b]Refined rollback netcode [/b]- ensuring low latency PVP gameplay across continents
[b]New characters[/b] - you now have access to 12 new characters with vastly different skills
[b]New mechanics[/b] - try out unique elemental mechanics such as bleed stacks and energy drain
[b]Story mode [/b]- embark on a grand adventure Explorer! Visit the unique biomes of the Stardust Dimension
[b]Daily missions[/b] - earn in game rewards through daily quests
[b]Gacha & rewards [/b]- new XP rewards and ways to spend your Stardust Gems
[b]Lobby Town (RIFT) [/b]- a truly massive multiplayer experience. Hang out with others in RIFT!
[b]Mayhem[/b] - A 25 player free-for-all mode set in a vast open world map
[b]Spectator Mode[/b] - watch other players fight it out in real time! E-sports is the end goal! 
[b]Cosmetics [/b]- flex your legendary and mythical weapons wherever you go
[b]Profile Cards[/b] - Collect beautiful cosmetics to display on your own personalised profile card!

notes.title: New PVP mode added! - Let the Mayhem begin!
notes.notes:
Hey Explorers! 

To facilitate for larger scale PVP battles, we have added the new game mode: [b]Mayhem Mode[/b]

This will allow up to 25 players to participate in all-out combat where the player with the most amount of kills wins over a 15 minute duration. Set in the vast open terrain of Biome 006, Mayhem battles will see players spawn across a wide variety of terrains. In addition to taking on other players, there will be treasure chests containing rewards, guarded by strong foes such as the Shinagawa Snipers or the Bufomorph King. Will you control the high ground and deal AOE damage? Or sneak around the heavily forested inland fields and stab your foes in the back? Countless ways to play, countless ways to win! 

[u]Mayhem Mode contains the following new features[/u] : 

[b]Leaderboard Toggle[/b] [ Tab ] - Winner takes all! There can only be one.
[b]Kills & Death Tracker[/b] - Real time tracking of match statistics
[b]Private matches[/b] - Play with your friends in password protected matches
[b]Public matches[/b] - Randomised matchmaking with Explorers around the world
[b]Treasures to unlock[/b] - guarded by insanely tough enemies
